newsitem.title: USA: Vista Gold gets okay for Guariche Project.
newsitem.headline: Vista Gold gets okay for Guariche Project.

text.p: Vista Gold Corp said Wednesday that it has received the necessary approvals to commence drilling on the Triunfo Number 1 concession at the Guariche Project in Venezuela.

Vista said its geologists have estimated a minimum geologic resource of 9.3 million tons at 0.06 ounces per ton of gold. The drilling program which is authorized as part of a baseline study, is designed to confirm a proven and probable mineable reserve of a minimum of 570,000 ounces.

Drilling equipment is currently being mobilized to the Guariche property and drilling should commence in the next two weeks, said the company, with initial drill results expected within four to six weeks.
Concurrently, the company said it will be generating the necessary environmental impact statement for submission to Venezuela's Minister of the Environment.
Vista said its long-term plan calls for production at Guariche to commence in the second half of 1999.
